Bill.BriefDescription: Authorizing the state lottery to provide scratch tickets as a promotional activity.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to scratch tickets as a promotional activity; andadding a new section to chapter 67.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 67.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The state lottery may provide as a promotional activity, freeor for a charge, scratch tickets to persons otherwise eligible topurchase lottery tickets, and to licensed retailers for distribution topersons otherwise eligible to purchase lottery tickets. Only scratchtickets with a retail price of one or two dollars may be used underthis section. The state lottery shall limit promotional scratchtickets to no more than one percent of the annual sales of one or twodollar scratch tickets. Promotional scratch tickets provided underthis section must be conducted in accordance with rules established forpromotional activities. Rules adopted under this section must includeaudit and reporting provisions. (2) The lottery commission must review the use of promotionalscratch tickets annually and report its findings to the appropriate p. 1 SHB 2280committees of the legislature. Subject to its annual review, thelottery commission must set quantity guidelines and may suspend the useof promotional scratch tickets on a fiscal year basis.
